item.title: Show HN: Algorithmically Finding the Longest Line of Sight on Earth
item.description:
📝 Hindu Kush to Pik Dankova (530km) ↗ The longest line of sight on the planet, at 530km, from the Hindu Kush to Pik Dankova Runners Up Longest lines of sight tend to group together around peaks and ridges. We’ve found a line of sight from the department of Antioquia to Pico Cristobal, Colombia’s highest mountain. Mount Elbrus to the Pontic Mountains (483km) ↗ The third longest line of sight, at 483km, from Mount Elbrus in Russia to the Pontic Mountains in Turkey Our pick for the third greatest view is from Mount Elbrus in Russia to the Pontic Moutains in Turkey.
